Privacy

Privacy statement

Last updated: 18 November 2026

Who we are

NexoIQ is a sole proprietorship registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KvK 42175764), based in the Rotterdam area, the Netherlands. NexoIQ is the controller for the personal data described in this statement.

Contact for privacy questions: info@nexoiq.nl.

What data we process

Contact form: your name, business email, company name, country, the service and engagement type you select, your project description, and your privacy consent.

Email: the details you include when you email us.

Hosting: our hosting provider processes technical data such as IP addresses in server logs to deliver and secure the website.

This website does not use analytics or tracking cookies.

Why we process it

To respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to prepare a proposal or agreement (steps prior to entering into a contract, and our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries). We do not use your details for newsletters or unrelated marketing.

Service providers

Netlify hosts this website and receives contact form submissions on our behalf. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and page styling from a content delivery network; these services receive your IP address when you load a page.

Some of these providers are based outside the European Economic Area. Where that is the case, transfers rely on safeguards recognised under the GDPR, such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.

How long we keep it

Enquiries that do not lead to an engagement are deleted within 24 months. If an engagement follows, related records are kept as long as needed for the engagement and for statutory retention periods, such as the seven-year Dutch tax retention obligation.

Your rights

You can ask for access to, correction or deletion of your personal data, restriction of or objection to processing, and data portability. Send your request to info@nexoiq.nl.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

Security

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, in proportion to the nature of the data and the risks involved.

Changes

We may update this statement. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
